purpose: 명문가 UI 디자인 후보. HTML 제작을 위한 시각적 참고 이미지.

sources.role: 현재 제품 범위, 권한과 상태, 예시 자료 원칙
설립, 운영, 법적 검토와 8개 상위 유즈케이스
알림 설정, 관리 메뉴와 상태 안내
회의 기록, 원문과 요약, 문서 중심 화면

notes: 화면은 생성형 이미지 시안이며 서비스 실행 화면이 아니다.
금액, 이름, 회의, 날짜, 응답 현황과 파일은 예시다. 공개 토지 기준값은 PRD를 참고했다.
A는 운영 홈, B는 회의록 검토, C는 종원 모바일 동의 화면이며 서로 연결해 사용할 수 있다.
같은 제품으로 구현할 때 로고와 컴포넌트 스타일은 통일한다.
후보 이미지는 브라우저에서 시각적으로 검토했다. 실제 데이터 연결이나 API 검증은 수행하지 않았다.
한국어 세부 문구와 날짜는 HTML 구현 단계에서 확정한다.

images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE finished, high fidelity desktop web application UI mockup image, landscape 16:10, approximately 1600 x 1000 pixels. Flat front-on full screen screenshot, edge to edge, crisp like a real Korean SaaS product. This is a visual proposal for a Korean clan administration service called "명문가" (Royal Family), used by a clan chair and secretary to manage members, meetings, consent, documents, jointly held land and legal review. All illustrative data must be labeled by a small quiet header badge "UI 시안 · 예시 데이터". This will be used as a reference for later HTML implementation.

Design direction A: a calm, professional administration home. Blend ZUZU's corporate administration and notification structure, flex's disciplined management workspace and grouped navigation, and Clova Note's clean document-oriented typography. Design an original product, do not put ZUZU, flex or Naver logos in this image. Off-white light gray canvas, white left sidebar and white panels, deep ink text, restrained forest green actions, soft sage selected menu, small warm amber review badges. Fine pale gray borders, 10–14 px corners, quiet spacing, beautiful precise grid. Clean Korean sans serif typography like SUIT, clear 30 px heading, body visibly readable. No gradients, glass, decorative illustrations or excessive numbers. Emphasize actionable work instead of generic KPI cards.

Composition:
- Persistent narrow left navigation about 210 px wide with a small original family-tree line symbol and brand "명문가". Workspace label "전주이씨 임영대군파 종중". Menus in well spaced groups: "종중 홈" selected, "설립 준비", "종원 명부", "재산·계약", "회계", "총회·동의", "자료실", "법률·문제 확인". At bottom "알림 설정" and quiet user role "총무".
- A white top bar with breadcrumb "종중 홈", modest search field "자료 검색", simple outline bell and circular initials avatar. Small preview badge above.
- Main heading exact "우리 종중의 오늘". Subline "총무님, 오늘 확인할 일이 있어요." A primary green action at the right "회의 녹음 올리기".
- A long soft sage meeting banner under the title, small simple calendar block showing "10월" and "24". Title "10월 정기총회 준비". Subtext "2026.10.24 · 오전 10:00". A small real process sequence: "안건 등록" and "대상자 확인" complete, "안내 검토" current, "참석·위임" upcoming. Button "총회 준비하기".
- Main grid below: left around 65% width, right around 35%.
- Upper left action list panel title "먼저 확인할 일" and small count "3". Three distinct rows with small outline icons, title and meaningful amber or muted status badges: "회의록의 금액 확인" / "확인 필요", "총회 소집 안내 검토" / "v0.3 초안", "미가입 종원 12명 안내" / "전화 안내 대기". Small source/time secondary text, unobtrusive chevrons.
- Lower left "동의 요청 현황" panel with slim stacked progress line and consistent data, "응답 32명", "미응답 16명", "대상 48명". Subtext "읽음과 동의 응답은 구분해요." Two example request rows: "운영비 집행안" with "v1.2" and "총회 안건 확인" with "v1.0". Never imply legally passed resolutions.
- Upper right financial summary titled "이번 달 회계" and tiny "샘플 금액". Large balance "1,550,000원", supporting lines "수입 2,400,000원" and "지출 850,000원", restrained horizontal bars, link "거래·증빙 보기". Amounts must be arithmetically consistent.
- Middle right land panel "공주시 태봉동 산41-1". Badge "공개 기준값", text "임야 · 14,154㎡", source "K-GeoP · 2026.10.09". Button "자료 확인". No declaration of legally verified ownership, no fake real-time alarm.
- Small bottom right activity rows "소집 안내 초안 등록" and "회의 원문 연결", understated times.
Keep a complete balanced workday dashboard and generous whitespace. Accurate readable Korean words as quoted. Icons consistent 1.5px outline. No laptop, perspective, browser address bar, photographic background, watermark or presentation annotations.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE finished, high fidelity Korean desktop web app screenshot image, landscape 16:10 approximately 1600 x 1000 pixels, perfectly flat front-on edge to edge. Product "명문가", a clan administration workspace. This candidate is the meeting transcription and minutes review screen, intended as a visual reference for HTML creation, not code. All records are examples, show a subtle top badge "UI 시안 · 예시 데이터".

Design direction B: a highly practical Clova Note inspired recording and document workbench inside a flex-like management app, with ZUZU-style clear review states and next actions. Original branding, never show other companies' logos. White and near-white surfaces, pale sage navigation selection, forest green primary action, small amber uncertain-text highlights, deep charcoal Korean sans serif text. Beautiful 8px spacing system, precise thin rules, no gradients or decorative hero graphics. Make this look usable and carefully typeset, with legible Korean typography. Quiet modular management feeling.

Layout:
- Narrow white sidebar about 210px: original small family-tree line emblem, brand "명문가", workspace "전주이씨 임영대군파 종중". Grouped menu: "종중 홈", "종원 명부", "재산·회계", "총회·동의", "회의와 기록" selected, "법률·문제 확인". Bottom a separated short meeting list: "10월 총회 준비 회의" selected, "9월 운영 회의", "규약 검토 회의". Short names, no visual crowding.
- White top navigation strip, breadcrumb "자료실 / 회의와 기록", slim search and role "총무", quiet prototype badge.
- Main title exact "10월 정기총회 준비 회의". Small metadata "2026.10.08 · 42분 18초 · 발언자 3명". Right small buttons "원본 보기", "회의록 내보내기". Clear state chip "검토 중".
- A restrained thin process line "녹음 등록 → 원문 확인 → 회의록 검토 → 동의 요청", current stage "회의록 검토".
- One white horizontal audio playback strip spanning the content, green circular play icon, a precise thin waveform with played portion green and remaining pale gray, time "08:32 / 42:18", file "총회준비회의.m4a", tag "시연".
- Below, two generous side-by-side workspace panels with a clear center gutter.
Left panel around 52%: title "음성 원문", speaker filter pills "전체", "회장", "총무", "종원". Transcript arranged in 4–5 roomy speaker blocks with circular initial avatars, speaker label and timestamp. Short exact Korean lines:
"회장" "00:26" : "이번 총회 안건부터 정리합시다."
"총무" "01:42" : "가입하지 않은 종원에게도 안내가 필요합니다."
"종원" "08:32" : "운영비는 팔십오만 원으로 들었습니다."
Highlight the words "팔십오만 원" softly in amber with adjacent tiny "금액 확인". A pale green selected paragraph connects to the summary. Footer subtle "원문을 기준으로 확인해 주세요."
Right panel around 48%: title "회의록 초안", small badge "AI 초안", version "v0.3". An orderly editable-document appearance with sections "논의한 안건", "정리된 내용", "다음 할 일". Short bullet copy about "정기총회 일정", "소집 안내 대상 확인", "운영비 집행안 검토". Each summary item includes a small green source-time citation such as "00:26", "01:42", "08:32". No generated decision passes, no legal validity claim.
Include a warm amber review callout: heading "확인이 필요한 내용", body "운영비 금액을 원문과 대조해 주세요.", button "금액 확인하기". Below a responsible-person row "검토 담당 · 총무" and small note "수정한 초안은 다시 검토해요."
At bottom right a quiet secondary "검토 의견 남기기" and a clear green primary "검토 완료". Downstream "동의 요청 준비" may be muted until review. Small file/version provenance footer, not technical jargon.
Keep both panels within the screen, deliberate whitespace and short readable lines. This image should express the source → structured draft → human review workflow immediately. No photos, device frames, browser chrome, large analytics charts, neon, floating decorative UI, English filler or watermark.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high fidelity Korean mobile app UI screenshot, portrait about 1080 x 1920 pixels. A complete single flat edge-to-edge phone screen, no device hardware frame, no perspective, no hand, no surrounding scene. The product is "명문가", a Korean clan community administration app. This is a design candidate for later HTML implementation, focused on an older clan member reading a decision notice and submitting their own consent. Show a quiet small header "UI 시안 · 예시 데이터" so fictional content is clear.

Direction C: ZUZU's clear notification and consent flow, the quiet readable spacing of Clova Note, and the structured trustworthy management feel of flex. Original family-tree emblem and Korean brand. Warm near-white background, white primary reading surface, ink navy text, muted slate blue actions, subtle pale sage confirmation states and restrained amber deadline badge. Beautiful consistent line icons, minimal borders, gently rounded 12px corners. Large readable Korean sans-serif type, 24–30px section heading in phone proportions, body 18px-equivalent, clear 52px-equivalent tap targets, generous breathing room. Not playful, not a marketing landing page, not a dashboard crowded with metrics.

Composition top to bottom:
- A very quiet phone status bar, then small prototype label.
- Compact header: original line family-tree mark and brand "명문가" left, bell icon right. Subtle clan label "임영대군파 종중".
- A friendly main heading "확인할 소식이 도착했어요". Subline "내게 온 요청을 확인해 주세요."
- Main large white request card or integrated white reading section, aligned flush with comfortable margins. State badges "동의 요청", "v1.2", small amber "10월 18일까지". Large title "정기총회 운영비 집행안". Supporting sentence exactly "총회 운영에 사용할 비용을 확인하고 의견을 남겨 주세요."
- Two clear rows, label "예정 금액" with emphasized "850,000원"; label "문서 버전" with "집행안 v1.2". Small unobtrusive "샘플 금액".
- A simple attachment row with document outline icon, exact "운영비 집행안.pdf", small "v1.2 · 총무 작성", clear "내용 보기" action and chevron.
- A short information box or fine caption "문서를 읽은 뒤 응답해 주세요." followed by two equally accessible choices with visually distinct styles. Primary slate blue filled button "동의합니다", bordered secondary "동의하지 않습니다". Below a wide quiet outlined button "의견 남기기". No preselected agreement, no misleading success tick.
- Small contextual note "이 응답은 집행안 v1.2에 대한 의견 기록입니다." Make it small but readable; don't claim legal resolution completed.
- Below, a compact pale gray upcoming-event section titled "다가오는 총회". Calendar tile "10월 24일". Title "10월 정기총회", details "오전 10:00", button "참석·위임 응답". Fit this comfortably above fixed navigation; avoid offscreen overflow.
- Fixed quiet bottom navigation with four clean icons and exact labels "홈" selected, "총회·동의", "자료", "내 정보". Bottom safe-area spacing.
All quoted Korean text must be crisp and correctly spelled. Use short content, substantial legible typography, no fake profile photos, no long legal prose, no money transfers, no charts, no browser or laptop frame, no watermark or outside explanatory labels. The screen should feel considerate and easy for a 60–70 year old member to read without becoming visually childish.
